definitions.explanation: A person who accompanies someone to provide care, assistance, or supervision. Often used in medical, caregiving, and child-related contexts.

examples.japanese: {付|つ}き{添|そ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}した→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{付|つ}き{添|そ}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: My mother was hospitalized, so I stayed at the hospital as her companion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{参加|さんか}できない→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}き{添|そ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: Children cannot participate alone, so a guardian must accompany them.

notes:
Derived from the verb ⟦{付|つ}き{添|そ}う→付き添う：10585_tsukisou⟧ (to accompany, to stay by someone's side).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {付|つ}き{添|そ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (attendant, companion)
- {付|つ}き{添|そ}い⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧ (hospitalization with a companion staying)
- ⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}き{添|そ}い (parental supervision/accompaniment)
- {付|つ}き{添|そ}いなし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (without an escort)

Very common in hospital settings where family members stay with a patient, and in situations involving children where adult supervision is required.
